Here is the rule: when a sentence has no action word, use am, is or are.
Right: "The giraffe is very tall."
Wrong: "The giraffe very tall." The word is is missing.
I think aloud with my example: "The zebra is black and white."
Step 1: Is there an action word? No.
Step 2: Who? The zebra. That is one animal, it.
Step 3: With it, I use is.
Now your turn. Write only the missing word:
I ___ a student.
